title: Southern Scenic Route | 100% Pure New Zealand
lines: Embark on an enchanting adventure through the lower South Island, where you'll discover awe-inspiring rare wildlife, dramatic landscapes, and mouthwatering seafood. This incredible itinerary promises unforgettable experiences, no matter the season.
. Along the way look out for the Mirror Lakes with their amazing reflective views. Rough hewn Homer Tunnel brings you into the amazing 22km fiord of Milford Sound.
